Hotel and Transit Info

Hotel Blocks

We have room block contracts at two local hotels: The Kissel Uptown Oakland, and the Residence Inn by Marriott Oakland Downtown. The Kissel is somewhat more convenient but also more expensive. The Residence Inn is less expensive, but it also doesn't have a minimum booking requirement, so we recommend going with the Kissel first and the Residence Inn second :P

The Kissel — 2455 Broadway, Oakland, CA 94612

Group rate: $179/night plus tax/fees
(Double queen bed rooms also available for $229/night)
Reservations must be received by September 4
Book Rooms Here
We are under contract with the Kissel, but haven't received our personalized group booking link just yet. Please check back in the next couple days!

Residence Inn — 1431 Jefferson Street, Oakland, CA 94612

Group rate: $129/night plus tax/fees
Reservations must be received by September 11
Book Rooms Here

Transportation

The Henry J. Kaiser Center is between 10th St. and Lake Merritt Blvd., right across from the Lake Merritt Amphitheater. The venue is just a couple blocks walk from the Lake Merritt BART station, but also has its own parking for $15.

We're planning to have an Uber voucher code for rideshares on the day of the reception. We'll send this out by email the week before, so keep an eye out for it!
