Registry

So, here's the thing... we have been legally married for five years now, and living together for twice that! At this point we really don't need anything that would traditionally be found on a wedding registry. Instead, here's a list of organizations we like, presented in random order:

  • Bring David McClary Home
  • Palestinian Children's Relief Fund
  • Alameda County Community Food Bank
  • Wikimedia Foundation
  • Internet Archive
  • Electronic Frontier Foundation
  • Planned Parenthood / PPAF
  • Silvia Rivera Law Project
  • The Coalition for Humane Immigrant Rights
  • ... or any other organization you personally believe in that aligns with the objectives of those above.

If you end up donating to any of these organizations in honor of our wedding, we'd love for you to let us know! :)



Slush Fund

If you really still want to give us a gift, the best possible gift would be for more of our friends to come join us for our wedding weekend. You can send a Venmo to @Kevin-McSwiggen mentioning \"wedding\" in the description to contribute to a slush fund expressly for this purpose.

If you are one of said friends and travel/hotel costs are a significant factor in your planning, PLEASE reach out to us!!! To reiterate, you being at our wedding is the best possible gift we could get, so we want to remove as much stress from that as possible.

If neither of these options seems appealing, and you still really really want to give something to us that's a gift for us, we appreciate it, and we certainly won't stop you!
...But we're also not gonna give you any hints. ;^)

Oh hey, you made it all the way out here :)
